panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: Totals for the selected range. Click a project or session to drill in.
panels.description: Every panel follows the time range and the Account, Project, Session, Actor and Skill variables. The rail on the left ignores them.

panels.title: cost_usd
panels.description: Sum of cost_usd of the api_request events in the dashboard time range (30 days by default). cost_usd is computed by Claude Code from API prices: on a subscription it is not a bill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd, 'sum of api_request cost_usd' AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: cache read / (cache read + input + cache create) tokens. 90 % and above green, 75 % and above yellow, below red; the cache tip fires below 40 %. Per project: Efficiency, Cache hit rate by project.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate, '≥ 90% good · < 75% bad' AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Billable tokens
panels.description: input + output + cache create tokens in the time range. Cache read tokens are not counted: they are 10-100x larger and cost a fraction of a normal token.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS billable, 'input + output + cache create' AS name
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Tool error rate
panels.description: Share of tool calls (tool_result events) that failed. Below 2 % green, 2 % and above yellow, 5 % and above red. The second line is the 95th percentile of the model request duration (api_request duration_ms).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT 100 * countIf(success = 0) / greatest(count(), 1) FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)) AS error_rate,
       concat('p95 API latency ', toString(round((SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)) / 1000, 1)), ' s') AS name

panels.title: Daily tokens & cache hit rate
panels.description: Bars (left axis): tokens per day. Input: new non-cached prompt text. Output: generated by the model. Cache create: written to the prompt cache. Cache read is not drawn: it is 10-100x larger and would flatten the bars. Line (right axis, 80-100 %): cache hit rate of the day; a lower value is clipped. Days are in server time (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output, sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_create,
       100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Per effective project (unknown = the project could not be determined): cost_usd, billable tokens (input + output + cache create), cache hit rate (90 % and above green, 75 % and above yellow, below red) and sessions with a model request. Click a project to filter the dashboard by it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT project, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens,
       100 * sum(cache_read_tokens) / greatest(sum(cache_read_tokens + input_tokens + cache_creation_tokens), 1) AS hit_rate,
       uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY project ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: cost_usd by model
panels.description: Share of cost_usd by model family (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku; Other = any other model name). The legend shows the share and the dollars.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'opus') > 0, 'Opus', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'sonnet') > 0, 'Sonnet', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'haiku') > 0, 'Haiku', 'Other') AS name, sum(cost_usd) AS value
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY name HAVING value > 0.005 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Work rhythm
panels.description: Model requests by weekday (rows) and 3-hour block (columns 00, 03, ... 21 = hours 00-02, 03-05, ...; server time zone, UTC in Docker) in the time range. Brighter = more requests: a cell is coloured by its share of the busiest weekday-block cell (below 8 % empty, then steps at 8, 30, 60 and 85 %); the cell text is hidden. A table with cell colours, because the Grafana heatmap has only a time X axis and cannot put the time of day on it, and a Grafana table cannot be narrower than 50 px per column, so 24 hour columns do not fit. All variables apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'][w.d] AS day,
       round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 0) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `00`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 1) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `03`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 2) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `06`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 3) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `09`,
       round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 4) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `12`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 5) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `15`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 6) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `18`, round(100 * sumIf(c, b = 7) / greatest(max(mx), 1)) AS `21`
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) AS d) AS w
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT dd, b, c, max(c) OVER () AS mx
  FROM (
    SELECT toDayOfWeek(ts) AS dd, intDiv(toHour(ts), 3) AS b, count() AS c
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY dd, b
  )
) AS t ON t.dd = w.d
GROUP BY w.d ORDER BY w.d

panels.title: Top tools
panels.description: Top 7 tools by number of calls (all variables and the time range apply).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 7

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: The six sessions with the latest prompt in the time range (account, project and session variables apply; sessions with a model request only). Name = title, else the first prompt. Model = the model with the highest cost in the session. Tokens = input + output + cache create over the whole session; cost_usd = the whole session. Click a name to open the session on Sessions (the time range zooms to the session; Back or the time picker returns); the link next to the title opens Sessions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.session_id AS session_id, if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.started), w.t0) - greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.last_event), w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.started), w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS from_ms, if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.last_event), w.t1) + greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.last_event), w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(s.started), w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS to_ms,
       if(s.title != '', s.title, leftUTF8(replaceAll(s.first_prompt, '\n', ' '), 100)) AS name,
       s.last_prompt AS last_prompt, s.project AS project, s.git_branch AS branch,
       multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(s.model, 'opus') > 0, 'Opus', positionCaseInsensitive(s.model, 'sonnet') > 0, 'Sonnet', positionCaseInsensitive(s.model, 'haiku') > 0, 'Haiku', s.model) AS model,
       r.tokens AS tokens, round(s.cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd
FROM
(
  SELECT * FROM cc.sessions
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
    AND requests > 0 AND last_prompt >= $__fromTime AND last_prompt <= $__toTime
  ORDER BY last_prompt DESC LIMIT 6
) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
  SELECT session_id, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens
  FROM cc.api_requests
  WHERE session_id IN (
    SELECT session_id FROM cc.sessions
    WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}')
      AND requests > 0 AND last_prompt >= $__fromTime AND last_prompt <= $__toTime
    ORDER BY last_prompt DESC LIMIT 6)
  GROUP BY session_id
) AS r ON r.session_id = s.session_id
LEFT JOIN
(
  SELECT session_id, min(a_s) AS t0, max(a_e) AS t1
  FROM
  (
    SELECT session_id, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - if(event = 'user_prompt', toInt64(0), toInt64(duration_ms)) AS a_s, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS a_e
    FROM cc.events_raw
    WHERE event IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request', 'tool_result')
      AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE event = 'user_prompt' AND ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime)
  )
  GROUP BY session_id
) AS w ON w.session_id = s.session_id
ORDER BY s.last_prompt DESC
